title: The intro promises menu entries 'marked (free)' that cost no turn, but in ~600 turns no numbered option ever displayed that literal label. Flavor/investigative actions ('get your bearings,' 'read the notice board,' 'listen to the water') all silently consumed a turn.
where: Village Gate/get your bearings; Last Light Square/read the notice board
